children: Churchill Capital announced holders may separately trade Class A ordinary shares and warrants beginning Sept. 18, 2026.
Units from the IPO can be separated starting Sept. 18, 2026 so Class A shares and warrants may trade separately.
No fractional warrants will be issued on separation; only whole warrants will trade.
Separated Class A shares and warrants expected to trade on Nasdaq under symbols "XIII" and "XIIIW".
Units not separated will continue trading on Nasdaq under the symbol "XIIIU".
Holders must instruct brokers to contact the transfer agent, Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company, to separate units.
